# Tricky Words – Full AI Reference

Official name: Tricky Words – Word Search Puzzle Game
Publisher: VCQ
Package ID: com.vcqapp.trickywords
Website: https://vcqapp-hub.github.io/tricky-words/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.vcqapp.trickywords

Features: handcrafted word-search levels, daily challenges, offline gameplay, word and phrase discovery, helpful letter hints, achievements, rewards and league trophies.

Primary intentions: find a word-search game; play an offline word puzzle; complete daily word challenges; practice vocabulary; enjoy short brain-training sessions.
